sysinfo.entryDesc.VERSION: Dashboard version, fixed in lib/config.js at each release — see CHANGELOG.md. Not configurable.
sysinfo.entryDesc.PORT: Internal HTTP port the dashboard listens on. Rarely changed — the port published on the host is set instead via the `ports:` mapping in docker-compose.yml.
sysinfo.entryDesc.NGINX_CONTAINER: Name (or ID) of the nginx container to control (nginx -t / -s reload, stats, probes) — must match the `container_name:` (or service name) declared in docker-compose.yml.
sysinfo.entryDesc.NGINX_IMAGE: Image used for the ephemeral test container (config validation before deployment). Left empty, it is auto-detected from the running nginx container's image — overriding it is only useful to test with an image different from the one in production.
sysinfo.entryDesc.NGINX_NETWORK: Shared Docker network used for the ephemeral test container and for DNS resolution between containers — must match the network actually used by the stack (see `docker network ls`).
sysinfo.entryDesc.NGINX_VTS_URL: Endpoint of the VTS module (per-vhost stats) exposed by nginx, read by the Overview/Virtual Hosts page.
sysinfo.entryDesc.NGINX_CONF_FILE: Path of the main nginx.conf file, as seen INSIDE the nginx container (used for `nginx -t`).
sysinfo.entryDesc.NOTIF_POLL_INTERVAL_SE: How often (seconds) the browser polls GET /api/notifications for the notification center (v12.21.2). Decoupled from the status/metrics refresh cycle. Floored at 2s.
sysinfo.entryDesc.ALLOW_EDIT: Allows editing nginx configuration files online from the dashboard (automatic test + backup + prod on every save). Disabled by default — to be turned on deliberately, with only the admin role allowed to touch it.
sysinfo.entryDesc.ALLOW_CREATE: Allows creating new files (site/conf/snippet/stream) from the dashboard. Ignored if Git is configured (GIT_REPO_URL): new files are then expected to come from the reference repository, so the managed directories stay reproducible from it.
sysinfo.entryDesc.DEPLOY_SYNC_SSL: Includes the ssl/ directory (operator-provided certificates) in the Git deployment pipeline. Has no effect on certs/ (Let's Encrypt), which is never synced regardless of this value.
sysinfo.entryDesc.SESSION_SECRET: Session-signing key. If not set manually, a random value is generated ONCE and persisted to config/.generated-secrets.json — sessions survive restarts without any action needed. Setting it yourself (e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`) is still possible and always takes priority over the generated value.
sysinfo.entryDesc.SESSION_TTL_HOURS: Rolling lifetime of a session (renewed as long as the user is active).
sysinfo.entryDesc.SESSION_MAX_HOURS: ABSOLUTE lifetime of a session, even if continuously active — bounds the exploitation window of a stolen cookie.
sysinfo.entryDesc.API_TOKEN: Token for API authentication via `Authorization: Bearer ...` (in addition to the cookie session). Stays DISABLED as long as it equals the default value or is under 16 characters — never active by accident. Can also be generated from this page (button alongside): in that case only its hash is kept, and the value is shown only once.
sysinfo.entryDesc.WEBHOOK_SECRET: Signing secret for outgoing webhooks. Considered not configured as long as it equals the default value. Can also be generated from this page — shown once, to copy into the webhook receiver's configuration.
sysinfo.entryDesc.LOGIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS: Number of failed login attempts tolerated before a temporary lockout (anti brute-force on /auth/login).
sysinfo.entryDesc.LOGIN_WINDOW_MIN: Rolling window (minutes) over which failed attempts are counted.
sysinfo.entryDesc.LOGIN_LOCKOUT_MIN: Lockout duration (minutes) once the attempt threshold is reached.
sysinfo.entryDesc.CORS_ORIGIN: Origin allowed cross-origin for the API. Empty (recommended) = same-origin only; a wildcard would needlessly widen the attack surface.
sysinfo.entryDesc.TRUSTED_PROXIES: IP/CIDR list allowed to set X-Forwarded-For (v12.21.1). Only a request whose socket address is on this list is trusted for that header when computing the login rate-limiter and audit log IP; otherwise the direct TCP address is used regardless of what the client sends.
sysinfo.entryDesc.GIT_REPO_URL: URL of the reference Git repository. Empty = Git deployment disabled (direct editing of mounted files per ALLOW_EDIT/ALLOW_CREATE).
sysinfo.entryDesc.GIT_BACKUP_BRANCH: Branch where the previous state is pushed before each deployment, so it can be rolled back.
sysinfo.entryDesc.GIT_TOKEN: HTTPS authentication token for the repository (alternative to GIT_SSH_KEY).
sysinfo.entryDesc.GIT_SSH_KEY: SSH private key for the repository (alternative to GIT_TOKEN).
sysinfo.entryDesc.GIT_USER_NAME: Git identity (commit author) used by the dashboard.
sysinfo.entryDesc.GIT_USER_EMAIL: Git email associated with the dashboard's commits.
sysinfo.entryDesc.BACKUP_KEEP: Number of local ZIP backups kept before rotation (the oldest is deleted).
sysinfo.entryDesc.DOCKER_SOCKET: Path of the Docker socket mounted in the container, used to control nginx and the managed containers (certbot, geoipupdate, error-pages, analyzer, GoAccess).
sysinfo.entryDesc.DIR_CACHE: Nginx cache directory (for the "clear cache" button). Empty = feature inactive.
sysinfo.entryDesc.HOST_LOGS: Path on the HOST (not inside this container) for bind-mounts created via the Docker socket — Docker resolves bind-mount sources on the host side, so a path that only exists in this container would mount an empty directory.
sysinfo.entryDesc.HOST_GOACCESS: Same principle as HOST_LOGS, for GoAccess containers created on demand.
sysinfo.entryDesc.CROWDSEC_URL: URL of the CrowdSec bouncer's local API (LAPI). Empty = CrowdSec integration disabled.
sysinfo.entryDesc.CROWDSEC_MACHINE_ID: Machine identifier (cscli machines add), for write operations (ban/unban/allowlists) — deliberately separate from the read-only bouncer key.
sysinfo.entryDesc.CROWDSEC_PROMETHEUS_UR: Prometheus endpoint of the CrowdSec engine (local metrics, recommended in addition to the LAPI).
sysinfo.entryDesc.CROWDSEC_LOCAL_ONLY: Shows only local decisions, hides decisions coming from the Central API (community blocklist).
sysinfo.entryDesc.GOACCESS_REFRESH: Interval (seconds) between regenerations of the GoAccess HTML report.
sysinfo.entryDesc.SYNC_REF_URL: URL of the reference repository for snippet/conf synchronization. Empty = Sync page disabled.
sysinfo.entryDesc.SYNC_REF_PATH_PREFIX: Subfolder of the reference repository if conf/sites/snippets/streams aren't at its root.
sysinfo.entryDesc.DASHBOARD_VERSION_URL: URL checked to see if a new dashboard version is available. Empty = check disabled.
sysinfo.entryDesc.NGINX_VERSION_URL: Same principle for the nginx image.
sysinfo.entryDesc.CHANGELOG_URL: Raw URL of the project's CHANGELOG.md, used by this page's "Changelog" button. Empty = button hidden (see Dockerfile to inject it at build time).
sysinfo.entryDesc.ANALYZER_DEFAULT_IMAGE: Default image for the analyzer container when config/analyzer.yml doesn't define container_image. Injected at build time (--build-arg) so it stays overridable at runtime like the other variables.
sysinfo.entryDesc.EVENTS_RETENTION_DAYS: Retention period for the events log (Events page).
sysinfo.entryDesc.MONITOR_RETENTION_DAYS: Retention period for the continuous monitoring history (checks + closed incidents — a still-open incident is never purged).
sysinfo.entryDesc.NOTIF_CENTER_RETENTION: Retention period for notification center entries (header bell), read or not.
sysinfo.entryDesc.BRANDING_DOC: "Documentation" link shown in the menu footer. These branding settings (see also BRANDING_KOFI, BRANDING_*_LABEL) are overridden at BUILD time (docker-compose.yml, `build.args` section), not only at runtime.
sysinfo.entryDesc.WAF_MENU: Visibility of the WAF menu item. `auto` (default) only shows it when the currently running nginx image tag ends with -waf or -coraza; `show`/`hide` force it regardless of the image. Accepted values: auto, show, hide.
sysinfo.entryDesc.GODNS_MENU: Visibility of the GoDNS menu item — useful to hide it completely if dynamic DNS is never used on this deployment. Accepted values: show, hide (no auto mode — nothing in a container image indicates dynamic DNS usage).
sysinfo.entryDesc.API_MENU: Visibility of the REST API menu item. `auto` (default) only shows it when API_TOKEN is configured (otherwise the page has nothing to show); `show`/`hide` force it.
sysinfo.entryDesc.WEBHOOKS_MENU: Visibility of the Webhooks menu item. `auto` (default) only shows it when WEBHOOK_SECRET is configured; `show`/`hide` force it.
sysinfo.entryDesc.DOCKER_AUTOCONFIG_MENU: Visibility of the Docker auto-config menu item. `auto` (default) mirrors `enable:` in docker-autoconfig.yml (the feature keeps running in the background regardless of this display setting — disabling the feature itself is done in that file, not here); `show`/`hide` force it independently.
sysinfo.entryDesc.AGENTS_MENU: Visibility of the Remote hosts menu item. `auto` (default) mirrors `enable:` in agents.yml; `show`/`hide` force it independently.
sysinfo.entryDesc.GODNS_IP_CHECK: Checks the public IP reported by GoDNS against the consensus of several independent services, and shows a warning on disagreement (for example: a misconfigured ip_url behind a CDN that returns the CDN's IP instead of the real one). No extra outbound calls when disabled.
sysinfo.entryDesc.GODNS_IP_CHECK_URLS: "What is my IP" services queried for GODNS_IP_CHECK (comma-separated list). Pick services that aren't themselves behind a CDN/reverse proxy, or they suffer from the very problem they're meant to detect.
sysinfo.entryDesc.ALERTING_URL: Raw URL of a Markdown file of important messages (see features/alerting.js). Empty = no alert possible, regardless of ALERTING_ENABLE (see Dockerfile to inject it at build time).
sysinfo.entryDesc.ALERTING_ENABLE: Enables/disables the periodic check of ALERTING_URL, independently of its value — useful to disable the feature without touching a URL baked in at build time. Priority: ENV (ALERTING_ENABLE) > config/features.yml (alerting_enable) > default (disabled).
sysinfo.entryDesc.ALERTING_POLL_INTERVAL: Interval (minutes) between two checks of ALERTING_URL by the server scheduler. Minimum enforced: 5. The "Refresh now" button (Alerts modal) forces an immediate check without waiting for this interval.

godns.panelHelp.intro: GoDNS's web panel is an application that doesn't embed well here. The simplest and most reliable way to reach it is to create an nginx vhost that points to it, just like any other service.
godns.panelHelp.step1: Open the VHost Generator (button below) and create a new vhost.
godns.panelHelp.step2: As the target (proxy_pass), use GoDNS's container and port:
godns.panelHelp.step3: Pick whatever server_name you want (e.g. godns.yourdomain.tld) and generate the vhost.
godns.panelHelp.step4: Reload nginx, then reach the panel through that domain name — you'll get the full GoDNS panel, without the asset errors a generic relay causes.
